name: HOL Guard
description: Installs HOL Guard, a local-first security layer for AI coding agents and agent supply chains.

version.description: HOL Guard release to install. Use latest or an exact PEP 440 version.

initHarness.description: Initialize HOL Guard for the Dev Container user. The CLI detects installed harnesses; named values document intent. Use none for a side-effect-free install.

strictMode.description: Enable strict security mode for the Dev Container user.
